title: Notice of Breach and Opportunity to Cure

sections.body_template:
To {recipient_name}:

{sender_name} gives notice concerning the {agreement_name} dated {agreement_date}.

sections.heading: Relevant Provision
sections.body_template: The relevant contractual provision is identified as {agreement_clause}.

sections.heading: Breach Identified
sections.body_template: The alleged breach is described as follows: {breach_description}

sections.heading: Requested Cure
sections.body_template: The requested corrective action is: {cure_action}. The stated cure deadline is {cure_deadline}.

sections.heading: Potential Consequences
sections.body_template: If the matter is not cured, the sender may consider the following action, subject to applicable law and the agreement: {consequence_description}

sections.heading: Reservation
sections.body_template: All rights and remedies are reserved. This template does not determine whether the stated cure period or remedy is legally valid.

source_note: Fictional demonstration template only. It is not based on any specific statute, court rule, or jurisdiction.
